director_decision: Retain the real CC0 Blender source and exports as an improved terrain study; reject final art and Unity acceptance pending cliff-contact, repetition, import fidelity, and mobile validation.
baseline: V1 triangulated cliff and flat grass; V2MCP two scanned CC0 rock donors with real TCP BlenderMCP contact correction; V3 unchanged geology plus baked CC0 ground photo/normal.
visible_improvements: faceted cliff silhouette replaced with scanned rock geometry and PBR relief
second scan breaks some repeated module appearance
flat grass changed to photographic earthy variation in matched camera render
remaining_defects: obvious repeated rounded boulder rhythm around perimeter
dark terrain-rock gap at the lip and disconnected contact stones
large empty ground, incomplete paths, vegetation and architectural environmental integration
distance from supplied reference remains substantial
qwen_role: Auxiliary only; its V2 report contradicted visible defects by claiming reference quality, so no Qwen visual gate.
gltf_portability_conclusion: Rock shading visibly differs on Blender 4.0.2 reimport. Structural GLB audit passes, but visual fidelity is not accepted across Blender versions; Unity not run.
